justifications.soundness: Claims about the kit's behavior match the actual commands and paths in the repo; the fault-containment claims (plugin fails open, hook fails closed) are stated precisely and match the code.
justifications.coverage: Covers install, fleet churn, morning-failure loop, economics, and escape hatches; the worked example in section 10 ties the whole pipeline to a concrete repository run.
justifications.consistency: No contradictions found; the fail-closed/fail-open division of labour is stated in section 4 and respected consistently in sections 5 and 14.
justifications.risk_awareness: Explicitly surfaces the two structural risks: a global plugin being mistaken for repo-local enforcement, and the deliberate escape hatch becoming a habit; both are called out as anti-patterns.
justifications.actionability: Every section ends in concrete commands or a checklist; the install recipe in section 9 is a copy-paste sequence with a verification checklist.
